events.title: Update 0.6.0 for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Deeper will be taking part in the Steam Next Fest, which will run from October 19th to 26th. Alongside our work on the sequel, we are releasing demo update 0.6.0, whose key highlights are:A skill system to improve your characterA performance boostBalancing changes (particularly to the swordfish, once again)Numerous fixesSeveral new languagesEach key change is detailed below. events.title: You're Safe Here
events.summary: Hello everyone! First of all, thank you so much for all the amazing messages and support! To be honest, we were aiming at 15k wishlists for the early access release, and it's pretty amazing to say we are already at... 40k! Seeing this incredible level of support truly motivates us to deliver the best game we possibly can.
